_doc: Golden set for the code-review eval. Each entry: a PR, what a good review MUST mention (regex, case-insensitive, matched against the whole review) and what it MUST NOT assert as a finding (regex matched only inside ### findings, i.e. 🔴/🟠 — the same text is allowed as a ❓ or ⚠️). Add an entry every time a review misses something a human caught, or invents something.

prs.note: Bundle simplification, branch 28 commits behind main. Golden findings established by hand during the v3→v4 rebuild (2026-09-09).

must_find.name: stale-merge revert of unrelated components (double-reviews-slider / image-tabs)

must_not_find.name: div wrapper imbalance across Liquid branches
